content: Kiara called about renewing her health policy (SH-123456) after submitting the renewal form and paying the premium. Vikram confirmed the policy details but encountered a system issue that left the policy status showing as expired. He assured Kiara he would escalate the problem and follow up by the end of the day to confirm the renewal is correctly updated.

action_items: Escalate the system issue to resolve the expired status
Follow up with Kiara by the end of the day to confirm the policy is updated
